Privacy

What we collect, why, and what you can ask us to do with it.

Draft: this is a starting template, not legal advice. Have a Nigerian lawyer review it, and fill in the bracketed details, before launch.

Last updated: [date]

Who we are

NDD, Nigeria Design District ("we", "us"), runs this website. We are based in Abuja, Nigeria. You can contact us about privacy at hello@example.com. [Add registered business name and address.]

What we collect

  • Newsletter: your email address.
  • Contact, enquiry and RSVP forms: your name, email, phone number if you give it, and your message.
  • Membership interest and membership: business details, contact person's name, email and WhatsApp number, links to your work, and your answers about what you want from NDD (including, if you choose to share it, a rough marketing budget).
  • Site usage: if we add analytics, anonymous information about pages visited. [Name the tool if you add one.]

Why we use it

  • To send the newsletter you asked for (you can unsubscribe at any time).
  • To reply to your message, or pass your enquiry to the studio you contacted.
  • To consider membership, plan programmes and fees, and publish member listings.
  • To manage event RSVPs.

We rely on your consent, or on our legitimate interest in running the service you asked us for, as allowed under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023. We never sell your data.

Who we share it with

When you send an enquiry to a studio, we pass your message and contact details to that studio. We also use service providers to run the site, such as our form service, email newsletter tool and hosting provider. [List them.] Some may store data outside Nigeria; we only use providers with appropriate safeguards.

How long we keep it

Newsletter emails until you unsubscribe. Messages and RSVPs for up to 24 months. Member listings for as long as the member stays listed, and 12 months after removal. [Adjust to your practice.]

Your rights

You can ask us for a copy of your data, to correct it, to delete it, or to stop using it. Email us and we'll respond within 30 days. If you're not happy with our response, you can complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC).

NDD brings together fashion, architecture, interiors, art and product design to showcase Nigerian creativity, support collaboration and connect creative businesses with opportunities.
